answer: One proof settles it, and it reads Austringer redtail warrant flown at the weathering yard, spelled out in full as each redtail is a training record witnessed by the hawking clerk. Walk the trail by hand: it is short enough to walk and long enough to trip a farm. Yesterday's yarrow, this morning's hollow, and a summit that never happened: read the file and the farm gives itself away. Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 40 per proof, 33240 for 831, owed every epoch with no exception. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
